개.forms: native number + 개: 사과 세 개
개.e: The all-purpose counter: 사과 한 개 = one apple. Different from 개 (dog).
개.t: When you don't know the right counter for an object, 개 usually works.

개.ex: 저는 집에서 개를 한 마리 키워요.
개.x: I have a dog at home.
개.t: Don't mix up with the counter 개 (items): 사과 두 개. Count animals with 마리: 개 두 마리.

발.x: My feet hurt because my shoes are small.

예쁘다.x: The flowers in the park are really pretty.
예쁘다.e: 예뻐요! = 'You're pretty / It's pretty!' — a very common compliment.
예쁘다.t: ㅡ drops before 아/어: 예쁘다 → 예뻐요.

라디오.ex: 저는 운전할 때 항상 라디오를 들어요.
라디오.x: I always listen to the radio when I drive.
라디오.e: From English 'radio'; pronounced with three clear syllables, ra-di-o.

절하다.x: The children bowed respectfully to their grandfather on Lunar New Year's Day.
절하다.e: 절 'bow' + 하다; a full bow means kneeling and lowering the head toward the floor.
절하다.t: A quick nod or bow in greeting is 인사하다; 절하다 is a deep, formal bow.

미루다.m: to put off, to postpone; to push (work) onto someone
미루다.ex: 오늘 할 일을 내일로 미루지 마세요.
미루다.x: Don't put off until tomorrow what you can do today.
미루다.e: Probably related to 밀다 'to push' — pushing a task later.
미루다.t: 남에게 일을 미루다 means 'to push your work onto someone else.'

아무튼.ex: 시간이 없으니까 아무튼 내일 다시 이야기해요.
아무튼.x: We're out of time, so anyway, let's talk again tomorrow.
아무튼.e: Probably shortened from 아무러하든 'however it may be'.

이끌다.forms: 이끌어요 · 이끌었어요 · 이끌 거예요 · 이끄세요 (ㄹ drops)
이끌다.x: Coach Kim led the team to the championship.
이끌다.e: 끌다 'to pull' with a leading 이- — pulling others along.

탕수육.ex: 짜장면 두 개하고 탕수육 하나 주세요.
탕수육.x: Two jajangmyeon and one sweet and sour pork, please.
탕수육.t: The famous debate: 부먹 (pour the sauce on) or 찍먹 (dip into the sauce)?

생산성.ex: 회사는 생산성을 높이려고 새 기계를 샀어요.
생산성.x: The company bought new machines to raise productivity.
생산성.e: Literally 'producing quality'; -성 = quality or nature: 생산성, 가능성.

임산부.ex: 지하철에는 임산부를 위한 자리가 따로 있어요.
임산부.x: The subway has seats set aside for pregnant women.
임산부.t: Seoul subways have pink 임산부 배려석 seats reserved for pregnant women.

번번이.m: every time, each and every time, invariably
번번이.x: He failed the exam every single time.
번번이.t: Usually for repeated bad outcomes, unlike neutral 매번.

틈틈이.forms: 틈틈이 + verb: 틈틈이 공부하다, 틈틈이 운동하다
틈틈이.m: in one's spare moments, whenever one has time
틈틈이.x: I memorize English words in spare moments on my commute.
틈틈이.e: 틈 'gap, spare time' doubled + -이 — 'in every gap'.

깔리다.m: to be spread, to be laid; to be crushed under; to be everywhere
깔리다.x: The road is covered with fallen leaves.
깔리다.e: Passive of 깔다 'to spread': literally 'get spread out' or 'get pinned under'.

사은품.ex: 화장품을 사면 사은품으로 작은 가방을 줘요.
사은품.x: If you buy cosmetics, they give you a small bag as a free gift.
사은품.e: Literally 'an item to thank you for your favor' — a thank-you gift to customers.
사은품.t: Used for store giveaways; for a personal present, say 선물 instead.

통행.m: passage, traffic (people or cars going through)
통행.ex: 공사 때문에 이 길은 차량 통행이 금지됐어요.
통행.x: Because of construction, vehicles are banned from this road.

카페 투어.ex: 주말에 친구랑 카페 투어를 가기로 했어요.
카페 투어.x: My friend and I decided to go café hopping this weekend.
카페 투어.e: From English 'café' + 'tour'; English speakers say 'café hopping'.
카페 투어.t: Pretty interiors and desserts get photographed and shared on social media.

몰래카메라.ex: 생일에 친구들이 몰래카메라를 해서 깜짝 놀랐어요.
몰래카메라.x: My friends pulled a hidden camera prank on my birthday, and I was really surprised.
몰래카메라.t: Often shortened to 몰카. Careful: 몰카 also means an illegal spy camera used to film people without consent, a serious crime in Korea.

밀키트.x: With a meal kit, dinner is ready in thirty minutes.
밀키트.t: A box with pre-cut ingredients and sauce: you still cook it yourself, unlike 간편식, which is already cooked and just needs heating.

정립하다.m: to establish, to define clearly (a concept or theory)
정립하다.ex: 그는 새로운 이론을 정립하는 데 평생을 바쳤어요.
정립하다.x: He devoted his whole life to establishing a new theory.
정립하다.t: Pronounced [정니파다]; 정립 is used for ideas (개념, 가치관), while 확립 fits systems and order.

쉴 새 없이.forms: 쉴 새 없이 + 울리다 / 일하다 / 말하다
쉴 새 없이.ex: 하루 종일 전화가 쉴 새 없이 울렸어요.
쉴 새 없이.x: The phone rang nonstop all day.
쉴 새 없이.e: Literally 'without a moment (새, from 사이) to rest'.

상법.ex: 회사를 세우려면 상법에 대해 어느 정도 알아야 해요.
상법.x: If you want to set up a company, you need to know something about commercial law.
상법.e: Literally 'trade law' — rules for companies and business deals.

의인화.x: In this fairy tale, the animals are personified.

선발대.x: The advance team arrived first and set up the camp.
선발대.t: Pronounced [선발때]; the group that comes later is 후발대.

추가경정예산.ex: 국회는 재난 대응을 위한 추가경정예산을 통과시켰습니다.
추가경정예산.x: The National Assembly passed a supplementary budget for disaster response.
추가경정예산.e: Literally 'additional revised budget' — extra spending added after the main budget.

소견서.m: doctor's note, medical opinion letter, referral
소견서.ex: 큰 병원에 가려면 동네 병원에서 소견서를 받아 오세요.
소견서.x: To go to a big hospital, get a referral letter from your local clinic.
소견서.e: Literally 'document of what was seen'; -서 = written document: 신청서, 계약서.
소견서.t: 진단서 officially certifies a diagnosis; 소견서 is the doctor's opinion, often used for referrals.

신뢰도.ex: 이 설문지는 신뢰도가 높은 도구로 알려져 있어요.
신뢰도.x: This questionnaire is known as a highly reliable instrument.
신뢰도.t: Pronounced [실뢰도] — ㄴ before ㄹ becomes ㄹ (liquidization).

석탑.ex: 불국사에는 다보탑과 석가탑이라는 두 석탑이 있어요.
석탑.x: Bulguksa Temple has two stone pagodas, Dabotap and Seokgatap.
석탑.e: Literally 'stone tower'; 탑 ultimately comes from Sanskrit 'stupa'.

에너지전환.ex: 에너지전환을 위해 태양광 발전에 대한 투자가 늘고 있어요.
에너지전환.x: Investment in solar power is growing for the energy transition.

감쪽같다.m: flawless, seamless (so no one can tell)
감쪽같다.x: The repair is so seamless that nobody can tell.
감쪽같다.t: The adverb 감쪽같이 is very common: 감쪽같이 속았어요 'I was completely fooled.'

제도화.x: In many countries, parental leave has been institutionalized by law.
